title: Weapons
summary: The sword lines, region, dungeon and slayer weapons, the Mending Wand and how weapon abilities work.

s.x: Weapons are what you hit monsters with. SkyRPG's weapons are not drops you hope for: almost all of them are crafted at the
from monster drops, boss tokens and the previous weapon in their line. Each line has a clear path, and the better weapons carry abilities and special effects.
is its base damage before anything else. Your stats then change it:
adds 1% to your melee damage per point. A weapon with 20 Strength is 20% stronger, and the Strength on your armour and talents stacks with it.
is the chance for a hit to be a critical hit (you start with 30%). A crit multiplies the hit by 1 + Crit Damage / 100 (you start with 50% Crit Damage).

Weapons also carry set effects and perks. "Heals 3% of the damage you deal" is life steal, "+40% damage to spiders" is a bane effect that only counts against that kind of mob, and "poison" or "sets on fire" apply to what you hit. See
Some weapons have an ability you use with right-click. There are two kinds:
are free but have a cooldown (tools such as the Treefeller axes and Skyward Burst).
cost mana and have a cooldown too. Your mana is 100 plus 1 per point of Intelligence (Starfall costs 50, Thunderclap 30, Riftstep 50, Void Rend 80, the Mending Wand's Mend 60).

Every ability announces itself with effects and sound, and the item shows its recharge as a dark sweep over its hotbar slot. If you try too early, or without enough mana, the action bar tells you why (in red, with a dull click) and nothing is spent. A long recharge ends with a chime and a green "ready" message while you hold the item. The big ones also give your screen a short shake, so you feel them land.
(Starfall Blade): a ring of stars opens under you and a target ring closes on

hostile mob within 6 blocks (up to 14). A star then falls out of the sky onto each one, nearest first, a star every tenth of a second, and every star lands with a flash, a ring, a burst of sparks and a bell note that climbs with each one. Each does 80 damage and flings the mob into the air. Three or more stars end with a bloom of light across the whole field.

(Stormedge): a blue shockwave rolls out of you, then lightning hits every hostile mob within 5 blocks (up to 12), nearest first, with a spark arcing from each to the next. Each takes 40 damage and is shocked (slowed hard) for 1.5 seconds.
(Voidreaver): a violet rift opens 3 to 4 blocks ahead of you and spins, and for 0.7 seconds it drags

hostile mob within 8 blocks (up to 16) towards it. Bosses and heavy mobs resist in proportion to their knockback resistance. Then the rift collapses with a shockwave, a flash and a thunderclap of sound: each mob takes 150 damage and Wither II for 3 seconds and is shoved outwards. Nothing is spent if there is nothing to rend.

(Riftblade): you tear through the air up to 8 blocks and leave a violet cut hanging along the path. Every hostile mob the cut touches takes 40 damage. It stops short of walls and costs nothing if a wall is in the way.
The main sword ladder is paid in

(dropped by levelled mobs, more often the higher their level, nine make a Valor Seal) and rare drops from monsters. Each sword is made from the one before it and keeps its name and enchantments. Combat gear unlocks at Combat 10, 18, 26, 35, 45 and 50.

s.x: is a wand, not a sword. It has 50 Intelligence and the ability

(right-click): it costs 60 mana and heals you for 40 health, with a 5 second cooldown, in a spiral of green and gold light. At full health it does nothing and costs nothing. Odessa Quill sells it at Quill's Curiosities for 18,000 coins. The Spellweave enchant (+55 Intelligence while held) goes on wands.
Enchants are the main way to improve a weapon beyond its base numbers (see

). Sword enchants include Keen (+40% damage at the top level), Hallowed Edge and Webcutter (more damage to the undead and to spiders), Bloodthirst (life steal), Frostbite, Venom Coat, Cleave (hits nearby enemies), Reaper's Mark, Titanbane and the ultimates Soulrend and Rift Echo. Bow enchants such as Deadeye, Splitshot and Starshot work with the vanilla bows and crossbows that Kestrel Vane sells.

The strongest weapons and tools are drawn with larger, animated art (sheens, lightning, embers, stars, runes) and the biggest blades are held larger. Turn this on or off in Settings, Interface, Detailed weapon art. Some weapons also show held particles around the hand (Settings, Gameplay, Weapon particles).
